description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeesSearchForm class, which extends the SearchForm class to provide specific search form behaviors for employee-related data within the SuiteCRM project. It customizes search criteria for active employees and filters users based on portal, group, and visibility settings.

classes.name: EmployeesSearchForm
classes.description: A subclass of SearchForm tailored for employee-specific search filtering, including methods for constructing the form based on previous search data and generating custom WHERE clauses for employee searches.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EmployeesSearchForm object by copying configuration and state from an existing SearchForm object.

methods.name: generateSearchWhere
methods.description: Generates an array of SQL WHERE clause snippets, adding specific filters for active employees and visibility restrictions.
